integrity: All computations are independently reproducible from the embedded verify_corona.py; proof covers infinite limits. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results require the complete-graph corona with strictly positive pendant-edge rates. The fixed-rate Gaussian regime and the varying-rate Poisson regime use different scalings. Only terminal jamming is analyzed. Historical priority remains provisional because the 1989 Pippenger full text could not be inspected.
title: Logarithmic Gaussian jamming and a parity-folded Poisson crossover on clique coronas
